messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — our postmortem follow-ups keep drifting. I want to propose a standard timeline template + required remediation owners + a comms cadence for follow-ups. Sketch below — react with :+1: if you're aligned or drop concerns.

kevin: +1 from me. Can we add explicit SLAs for owner ack and remediation due dates? Last few drifts were just due to lack of explicit ownership.

sasha: Agree. I can prototype a tracker in a sheet or add a minimal table to the incident playbook. We should also capture recurrence_count so we can spot repeating issues.

maria: Proposed timeline (rough):
```
- 0h: incident declared, IC assigned, postmortem thread created
- 24h: initial postmortem draft + list of candidate action items
- 48h: remediation owners assigned + due dates set (owners must ACK)
- 7d: implementation check-in (short status + blockers)
- 30d: verification & closure (owner confirms tests/metrics)
- 90d: recurrence review (if incident reappears, escalate trend)
```

jon: Love the 48h ack rule. Suggest SLAs: owner ack <= 48h, mitigation plan <= 7d for P0/P1, full remediation <= 30d for P0 unless approved exception. Also we should stamp each action item with an explicit verification step.

kevin: For tracking fields, I propose CSV header we can use in sheets or in our tracker: 
```
incident_id, incident_date, severity, action_item, owner, owner_ack_ts, due_date, status, verification_steps, linked_pr, recurrence_count, notes
```
This keeps the schema simple and searchable.

maria: Comms cadence suggestions:
- initial thread update at 24h (short summary)
- weekly brief until remediation done for long-running items
- short canned messages for support-facing channels (e.g., status page, customer comms) generated by incident-bot when status changes

incident-bot: reminder: we can schedule auto-checks at 7d and 30d. I'll send a DM to remediation owners on those dates if a status hasn't been set. Use `/incident followup create <incident_id> 7d 30d` to enable.

sasha: I'll volunteer to pilot this for the next 3 incidents. Plan: create a tracker sheet, a lightweight PR to add the timeline template to the playbooks repo, and wire incident-bot followups. ETA for pilot artifacts: EOW.

kevin: One extra ask — add a small ownership rotation note: IC rotation stays the same, but follow-up ownership should be explicit and can be reassigned to an engineering owner (not necessarily the IC). Also, let's keep a short rotation calendar (weekly) for the "remediation oncall" role so we don't rely on ad-hoc owners.

maria: Agreed. I'll make the follow-up owner a required field on the postmortem form and add a "remediation-oncall" slot to the rota. I'll open the PR to playbooks and ping this thread when done. Thanks all! :tada:
